mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT case when T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} then T1.P_TRADE_ID ELSE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID END id, case when T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} then T1.P_TRADE_ID ELSE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID END text
,T1.PORTFOLIO_ID
FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1
T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND T1.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NULL AND T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE IN (#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE137}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE138})
and (instr(TOTLE_TRADE_ID, #{search}) > 0)

select.if: SELECT '05' statusValid, WTT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, WTTA.MP_FINPROD_ID, WTT.TG_BUSI_TYPE tradeType, WTT.PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, MCP.COUNTER_NAME, WTT.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, SSAI.SEC_ACCT_NAME, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, FP.FINPROD_ID, WTT.CCY, WTT.TRADE_MARKET, NVL(FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FP.FINPROD_NAME) finprodAbbr, TO_CHAR(FP.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDateWhole, TO_CHAR(FP.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDateWhole, TO_CHAR(WTT.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') VDATE, TO_CHAR(WTT.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') MDATE, TO_CHAR(WTT.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') PAY_DATE, WPTT.RATE*100 rangeYield, TPD.SHARE_AMT amount, WTT.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, null WORKFLOW_ID, WTT.INT_AMT, WPTT.THEORY_INT, WPTT.PRIN prinAmt, WPTT.UNIT_INT unitIntAmt, WPTT.UNIT_PRIN unitPrinAmt, WPTT.THEORY_PRIN THEORY_PRIN_AMT, WPTT.THEORY_AMT FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WTT LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD WTTA ON WTT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = WTTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WPTT ON WTT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = WPTT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON WTT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SSAI ON SSAI.SEC_ACCT_ID = WTT.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PP.PORTFOLIO_ID = WTT.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY MCP ON WTT.COUNTER_ID = MCP.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD ON WTTA.MP_FINPROD_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID WHERE WTT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} AND WTT.PORTFOLIO_ID

SELECT t1.*, ROUND(100 - SUM(NVL(fcp.PRIN_AMT, 0)), 6) unitPrinAmt FROM ( SELECT '01' statusValid, null TOTLE_TRADE_ID, t8.TRADE_ID MP_FINPROD_ID, t8.BRANCH, t8.tradeType, listagg(t8.CASH_TYPE, ',') WITHIN group (order by t8.cash_id) cashType, listagg(t8.cash_id, ',') WITHIN group (order by t8.cash_id) cashId, t8.PORTFOLIO_ID, t8.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T8.COUNTER_ID, MCP.COUNTER_NAME, t8.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, ssai.SEC_ACCT_NAME, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, FP.FINPROD_ID, FP.REGIST_ORG, TO_CHAR(FP.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDateWhole, TO_CHAR(FP.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDateWhole, t8.CCY, t8.TRADE_MARKET, NVL(fp.FINPROD_ABBR, fp.FINPROD_NAME) finprodAbbr, TO_CHAR(min(t8.VDATE), 'yyyy-MM-dd') VDATE, TO_CHAR(t8.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') MDATE, TO_CHAR(t8.PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') payDate, max(t8.RANGE_YIELD)*100 rangeYield, null TRADE_DATE, t8.AMOUNT amount,/*券面总额*/ null tradeAmt, NULL WORKFLOW_ID, SUM(T8.INT_AMT)*t8.AMOUNT/100 INT_AMT, /*债券借贷交易的share_amt存的是券面总额*/ SUM(T8.INT_AMT)*t8.AMOUNT/100 THEORY_INT, /*债券借贷交易的share_amt存的是券面总额*/ SUM(T8.PRIN_AMT)*t8.AMOUNT/100 THEORY_PRIN_AMT, /*债券借贷交易的share_amt存的是券面总额*/ SUM(T8.INT_AMT) unitIntAmt, SUM(T8.PRIN_AMT) prinAmt, SUM(t8.PRIN_AMT + t8.INT_AMT)*t8.AMOUNT/100 THEORY_AMT/*债券借贷交易的share_amt存的是券面总额*/ FROM ( SELECT ASP.TRADE_ID, ASP.BRANCH, ASP.FINPROD_ID, ASP.SHARE_AMT AMOUNT, ASP.tradeType, ASP.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, ASP.PORTFOLIO_ID, ASP.CCY, ASP.TRADE_MARKET, ASP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, ASP.COUNTER_ID, ASP.CASH_TYPE, ASP.CASH_ID, ASP.VDATE, ASP.MDATE, ASP.PAY_DATE, MAX(ASP.RANGE_YIELD) RANGE_YIELD, NVL(ASP.PRIN_AMT, 0) PRIN_AMT, NVL(ASP.INT_AMT, 0) INT_AMT FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TPD.TRADE_ID, TPD.BRANCH, /*金融产品交易表.交易编号 交易编号*/ FCP.FINPROD_ID, /* 金融产品交易表.金融产品代码 金融产品代码*/ TPD.SHARE_AMT,/*债券借贷交易的share_amt存的是券面总额*/ CASE WHEN TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F29' THEN '137' ELSE '138' END tradeType, /* CASE 金融产品交易表.金融产品类型（投管分类） when 'F29' THEN 数据字典.投管业务类型.融入债券付息还本（付） ELSE 数据字典.投管业务类型.融出债券收息还本（收） END 类型*/ TPD.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, /* 金融产品交易表.证券管理户代码 证券管理账户*/ PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, /* 金融产品交易附属表.组合代码 组合代码*/ PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, /* 组合.组合名称 组合名称*/ TPD.COUNTER_ID, TPD.CCY, TPD.TRADE_MARKET, FCP.VDATE, /* 现金流计划.调整后的计算开始日 计划开始日*/ FCP.MDATE, /* 现金流计划.调整后的计算结束日 计划结束日*/ FCP.CASH_AMT, /* 现金流计划.计划支付现金流 计划支付现金流*/ FCP.PRIN_AMT, /* 现金流计划.计划支付本金 计划支付本金*/ FCP.INT_AMT, /* 现金流计划.计划支付利息 计划支付利息*/ FCP.CASH_ID, /* 现金流计划.现金流代码 现金流代码*/ FCP.CASH_TYPE, /* 现金流计划.现金流类型 现金流类型*/ FCP.PAY_DATE, FCP.RANGE_YIELD /* 现金流计划.调整后的计划支付日 计划支付日*/
FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID INNER JOIN FIN_DEAL_TARGET FDT ON TPD.TRADE_ID = FDT.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN FCP ON FCP.FINPROD_ID = FDT.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID AND fcp.MDATE > tpd.TRADE_DATE AND tpd.MDATE >= fcp.MDATE INNER JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' WHERE tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F29', 'F30') AND tpd.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND tpd.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND FCP.CASH_TYPE IN ('01', '02', '03', '04') AND (fcp.PRIN_AMT > 0 OR fcp.INT_AMT > 0) AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tt INNER JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD ta ON tt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = ta.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE tt.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND tt.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND tt.MDATE = fcp.MDATE AND TT.FINPROD_ID = FCP.FINPROD_ID AND TT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PT.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TA.MP_FINPROD_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID ) AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tt INNER JOIN WFL_TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD ta ON tt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = ta.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE tt.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND tt.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND tt.MDATE = fcp.MDATE AND TT.FINPROD_ID = FCP.FINPROD_ID AND TT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PT.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TA.MP_FINPROD_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID )
AND pp.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TPD.TRADE_ID = #{mpFinprodId} AND FCP.CASH_TYPE = #{cashType} ) ) ASP GROUP BY ASP.TRADE_ID, ASP.BRANCH, ASP.FINPROD_ID, ASP.SHARE_AMT, ASP.tradeType, ASP.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, ASP.PORTFOLIO_ID, ASP.CCY, ASP.TRADE_MARKET, ASP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, ASP.COUNTER_ID, ASP.CASH_TYPE, ASP.CASH_ID, ASP.VDATE, ASP.MDATE, ASP.PAY_DATE, ASP.PRIN_AMT, ASP.INT_AMT) T8 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON T8.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SSAI ON SSAI.SEC_ACCT_ID = T8.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY MCP ON T8.COUNTER_ID = MCP.COUNTER_ID GROUP BY t8.TRADE_ID, t8.BRANCH, t8.tradeType, t8.PORTFOLIO_ID, t8.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T8.COUNTER_ID, MCP.COUNTER_NAME, t8.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, ssai.SEC_ACCT_NAME, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, FP.FINPROD_ID, FP.REGIST_ORG, FP.VDATE, FP.MDATE, t8.CCY, t8.TRADE_MARKET, fp.FINPROD_ABBR, fp.FINPROD_NAME, t8.MDATE, t8.PAY_DATE, t8.AMOUNT) t1 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp ON 'F01' = fcp.FINPROD_TYPE2 AND fcp.MDATE < to_date(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND T1.FINPROD_ID = fcp.FINPROD_ID and fcp.CASH_TYPE IN ('02') and fcp.PRIN_AMT > 0 GROUP BY T1.statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, T1.MP_FINPROD_ID, T1.BRANCH, T1.tradeType, T1.cashType, T1.cashId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T1.COUNTER_ID, T1.COUNTER_NAME, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T1.SEC_ACCT_NAME, T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.REGIST_ORG, T1.vDateWhole, T1.mDateWhole, T1.CCY, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.finprodAbbr, T1.VDATE, T1.MDATE, T1.payDate, T1.rangeYield, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.amount, T1.tradeAmt, T1.WORKFLOW_ID, T1.INT_AMT, T1.THEORY_INT, T1.THEORY_PRIN_AMT, T1.unitIntAmt, T1.prinAmt, T1.THEORY_AMT
